activities.name: dentTissueSort

config.prompt: Four tissues, layered partnership — file each fact:

items.label: 96 percent mineral, hydroxyapatite prisms, no cells
the hardest substance in the human body
tens of thousands of tubules per square millimetre
cold, sweet and pressure travelling as fluid shifts
capable of laying down new mineral from its lining cells
nerve and vessels sealed in rigid walls

config.why: Each layer's structure dictates its behaviour — four tissues, four different engineering problems.

activities.caption: welded vs hung — drag the divider
activities.name: dentSlingCompare

config.prompt: The tooth's suspension — drag between the picture and the reality:

before.label: Welded — the intuition
before.text: A tooth fused to bone would take every bite as a hammer blow, and a knock would go straight to the structure.

after.label: Hung — the reality
after.text: A sling of collagen fibres in remodelling bone cushions chewing loads, shares shocks, and lets light continuous forces move teeth through bone.

config.why: Several hundred newtons on a molar, thousands of cycles a day, for decades — the suspension is how.

activities.anchor: form tracks function to an extent visible in fossils
activities.caption: walk the extracted-molar decision
activities.name: dentMolarBranch

config.root: A lower first molar is extracted. The patient asks: 'It is a back tooth — can I just wait?'

start.text: What happens to the gap over the next few years?

choices.label: Neighbours drift into it and the tooth above over-erupts
choices.feedback: The quadrant's load pattern reorganises — replacing promptly is structural maintenance, not cosmetics.

choices.label: Nothing — the remaining teeth hold their positions
choices.feedback: The socket picture, wrong in the way that matters: the suspension is living ligament in remodelling bone.

replace.text: The bite now meets differently, and the joint is among the body's most used. Any clicking or ache reported?

choices.label: Load reduction first — softer diet, habit correction, a splint
choices.feedback: Reduce the load and let biology adapt: the engineering instinct that is the standard of care.

choices.label: Refer straight to joint surgery
choices.feedback: Surgery is the last resort — temporomandibular disorders are managed conservatively first.

done.text: The gap addressed in time, the load managed: the engineering read of a biological machine.

static.text: Teeth drift when neighbours are lost and over-erupt when unloaded — an ongoing structural event, not a cosmetic gap.

surgery.text: Clicking, limiting pain and muscle ache usually begin with load reduction — the biology adapts when the forces allow it.

config.why: One extracted molar can destabilise a whole quadrant's bite over years — occlusion is load engineering under lifelong revision.

activities.anchor: a collapse of the tooth's main chemical defence
activities.caption: pair each saliva job with what it buys
activities.name: dentSalivaMatch

config.prompt: Saliva does five jobs at once — pair each with what it delivers:

pairs.right: claws plaque pH back up after a sugar crash
chemically poised to rebuild enamel at every opportunity

pairs.left: carries lysozyme, lactoferrin and immunoglobulin A

pairs.right: speech and swallowing run on it

config.why: 0.5 to 1.5 litres a day from the glands — which is why a dry mouth is a defence collapse, not a comfort problem.

activities.anchor: Worth knowing how big that crash is
activities.caption: call the acidity multiplication
activities.name: dentPhEst

config.prompt: pH is logarithmic — plaque falling from a neutral 7 to the critical 5.5 is how many times more acidic?
config.why: More than thirty times — each whole pH unit is a tenfold change, so the crash is a multiplication, not a 20 percent increase.
config.context: The recovery is the other half of the curve: bicarbonate and supersaturated saliva claw the pH back over about half an hour.

activities.anchor: which is why so much therapy is mechanical
activities.caption: find the faulty line — inflammation in the mouth
activities.name: dentInflamSpot

config.prompt: One of these inflammation claims is backwards — click it:
lines: Acute inflammation runs redness, heat, swelling, pain, lost function.
Pulpitis: pain without swelling — inflammation in an unyielding box.
An abscess at a root apex: pus under pressure, the classic dental swelling.
Gingivitis: red, bleeding gums — permanent destruction from the first day.
Whether inflammation resolves or destroys depends on whether the stimulus persists.
config.correction: Gingivitis is fully reversible — remove the biofilm at the gum margin and the gums return to health.
config.why: The stimulus is usually a biofilm the immune system cannot finish off — remove the reservoir and the inflammation resolves on its own.

activities.anchor: all in under a second, repeated hundreds of times a day
activities.caption: sequence the swallow reflex
activities.name: dentSwallowOrder

config.prompt: One of the body's most choreographed reflexes — put it in order:
items: The tongue propels the bolus back
The soft palate seals off the nose
The larynx rises and its entrance folds shut
Breathing pauses for the moment of passage
config.why: Dentistry sits directly upstream: missing or painful teeth change what food people choose and how the bolus forms.

activities.anchor: hence the surgical convenience of doing grafts inside the mouth
activities.caption: fill the blanks — healing, three ways
activities.name: dentHealCloze

config.text: Oral %%0%% is among the fastest-healing tissue in the body — warmth, moisture and rich blood supply. Bone heals by the granulation-to-callus-to-remodelling sequence, and titanium integrates by %%1%%, the load-bearing bond that makes implants possible. But uncontrolled %%2%%, smoking, malnutrition and immunosuppression each slow it — the medical history is the prediction model.
config.hint: The lining, the metal bond, and the metabolic disease that slows everything.
